units.source_text: 新任右大将夕雾，威势比往日更加盛大了。

en.t: The newly appointed Captain of the Right, Yugiri, now enjoyed even greater power and prestige than before.

units.source_text: 因此今日的仪式自然特别隆重。

en.t: For that reason, today's ceremony was naturally conducted with exceptional solemnity and splendor.

units.source_text: 冷泉帝所赐御马四十匹，由左右马寮及六卫府官人从上方顺次牵下来，并列在庭前。

en.t: The forty imperial horses bestowed by Emperor Reizei were led down in order from above by officials of the Left and Right Stables and the Six Guards, and were lined up before the garden.

units.source_text: 其时日色已暮，照例表演《万岁乐》《贺皇恩》等舞乐。

en.t: By then the light of day had already faded, and, as usual, dances and music such as Banzairaku and Kakouon were performed.

units.source_text: 但只是应名而已，不久舞罢，堂上就开始管弦之会。

en.t: But these were only formalities in name, and before long the dancing ended and a gathering of wind and string music began in the hall.

units.source_text: 因有太政大臣在场，这管弦合奏特别出色，诸人无不用心献技。

en.t: Because the Grand Minister was present, the ensemble was especially splendid, and everyone devoted themselves to showing their finest skill.

units.source_text: 琵琶照例由萤兵部卿亲王弹奏。

en.t: As usual, the biwa was played by Prince Hotaru, the Minister of War.

units.source_text: 此人对无论何事都很擅长，世间少有其例，无人比得上他。

en.t: He was accomplished in everything he did, a rarity in the world, and no one could equal him.

units.source_text: 源氏弹七弦琴，太政大臣弹和琴。

en.t: Genji played the seven-stringed kin, while the Grand Minister played the wagon.

units.source_text: 源氏多年不曾听赏太政大臣的和琴了，想是因此之故，今日听来觉得特别优美。

en.t: Genji had not listened to the Grand Minister's wagon for many years, and perhaps for that reason it sounded especially beautiful to him today.

units.source_text: 于是他自己也就在七弦琴上大显身手，毫无保留。

en.t: So he too displayed his full mastery on the seven-stringed kin, holding nothing back.

units.source_text: 两人都奏出异常优美的音乐。

en.t: Both of them produced music of extraordinary beauty.

units.source_text: 弹毕，两人共话往事，说到今日情状：亲戚之谊既深，友爱之情又厚，万事无不和睦商量。

en.t: When they had finished playing, the two spoke together of the past and then of their present circumstances: their family ties were deep, their affection as friends was warm, and in all matters they consulted together in harmony.

units.source_text: 话语投机，心情舒畅，便举杯痛饮。

en.t: Their conversation suited them perfectly, their spirits grew easy and bright, and they raised their cups and drank deeply.

units.source_text: 逸兴源源而来，无有已时。

en.t: Their elegant delight flowed on without end.

units.source_text: 二人醉后感伤，流泪不止。

en.t: After they were drunk, both men became overcome with feeling and could not stop shedding tears.
